translations.modulePacks.intro: A pack is a set of modules declared with the Flyto2 module contract. Installing one adds its modules to this computer: they appear in the workflow builder, and AI Space can use the whole pack. Packs run only on this computer, never on Flyto2 servers.

translations.modulePacks.outcome.restartRequired: Restart Flyto2 to finish: code from the previous version stays loaded until then.
translations.modulePacks.publish.hint: Upload a pure-Python wheel named flyto-modules-* (20 MB at most) with exactly one flyto.modules entry point. The server reads it as data and never runs it.
translations.modulePacks.publish.messageToSign: Sign exactly this text with the private key of the selected key (Ed25519), then paste the base64 signature below.
